baseline_models.focus_anchor: فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ دَعَوُا ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ ... إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ ... يُشْرِكُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The vessel amid unstable water removes ordinary supports, so address, allegiance, and obedience are filtered to one recipient. Rescue transfers the riders to dry land, where the field of possible partners reopens.

activation_trace.role: The ship is the literal carrier whose exposure supplies the bounded crisis chamber.
Agitated back-and-forth water supplies the instability that strips away usable supports.
Calling and verbally inclining toward an addressee makes the crisis response relational rather than merely inward.
Purification after admixture makes exclusive devotion a filtered state produced under pressure.
Obedience and submission identify what is temporarily concentrated on God.
Rescue by separation supplies the decisive transfer out of the threatening medium.
Dry land is the literal zone in which ordinary agency and alternatives return.
Partnership restores multiple claimants to an allegiance that had just been singular.

changed_reading.before: They pray sincerely during danger and relapse after reaching shore.
changed_reading.after: The verse is a pressure-filter experiment: unstable passage concentrates address and obedience on one recipient, while restored land agency reopens a portfolio of partners.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus aligns two separation processes: the riders enact a devotional clearing, and God enacts bodily extraction. Their immediate partnership on land shows that physical release can succeed while durable release of allegiance fails.

activation_trace.role: Escape from an entanglement casts their professed devotion as an attempted inward disentangling.
Exclusive specification apart from partnership names the devotional separation at issue.
Actual rescue by separation provides the successful bodily counterpart.
Renewed participation marks reattachment after bodily extraction.

changed_reading.before: Sincerity, rescue, and relapse are three successive facts.
changed_reading.after: The sequence compares two extractions: God completes the physical one, but the human clearing of allegiance does not remain complete.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَإِذَا رَكِبُوا ... فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰهُمْ ... إِذَا هُمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The circular branch of the vessel root and the two abrupt condition markers activate a recurrent circuit rather than a single anecdote: enter exposure, concentrate allegiance, exit exposure, redistribute allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Riding or taking on an affair supplies entry into a condition, not only mounting a conveyance.
Circular motion supplies the exploratory image of a behavioral return loop.
Habit or customary state lets devotion be tested as condition-dependent practice.
Land is the alternating environmental pole opposite the vessel.
Partnership is the recurrent post-crisis state to which the circuit returns.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports one abrupt contradiction between sea and shore.
changed_reading.after: The verse can model a renewable condition-cycle in which environmental rotation repeatedly rotates the distribution of allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's opening assay frame and its pressure-responsive professions revise the focus sincerity from proof of settled identity into a real but local assay state. Crisis reveals what dominates when alternatives fail, while the post-crisis exit reveals what persists.

activation_trace.role: Purity after mixture remains a genuine local concentration, but context tests its duration.
Assaying metal or a person supplies the governing distinction between a pressured disclosure and an untested claim.
Repeated assay makes temporal persistence part of what the disclosure must establish.
Affliction supplies a social-pressure case in which declared affiliation changes with perceived danger or aid.
A visible entrance with a concealed exit gives the profession a structure of public entry and latent withdrawal.

structural_cues: 29:2-3 place professed faith under repeated testing before the focus scene.
29:10-11 juxtapose declarations made under affliction and after aid with the naming of hypocrisy.
The focus itself gives two rapid state disclosures, one in danger and one after rescue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, pressure-sensitive declarations, and a concealed-exit image; I infer that each condition discloses a locally real allegiance without by itself proving continuity. A live alternative is that the sea declaration is wholly insincere rather than sincere but unstable.

changed_reading.before: Emergency sincerity is either accepted as true or dismissed as hypocrisy.
changed_reading.after: Emergency sincerity is assay evidence: it truthfully exposes the current hierarchy of dependence, while the shore response separately exposes that the hierarchy was not stabilized.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier rescues repeatedly separate persons from flood, fire, and a doomed settlement. The focus therefore joins a surah-wide extraction series in which removal from a hazard is demonstrably effective but does not by itself settle the rescued person's later allegiance.

activation_trace.role: The focus rescue is literal extraction from the maritime threat.
Noah's extraction supplies an earlier successful rescue through the same root.
A ship cutting the face of the water supplies the earlier vessel-rescue template.
Extraction from fire shows that the rescue mechanism is separation from danger, not water-specific escape.
Promised extraction of Lot and his household introduces the boundary of who is carried out.
The repeated household rescue confirms extraction while preserving an explicit exception.

structural_cues: 29:14-15 pair flood, companions, ship, rescue, and an enduring sign.
29:24 and 29:32-33 repeat rescue across unlike hazards and specify the rescued set.
29:65 repeats rescue but uniquely foregrounds what the beneficiaries do immediately afterward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated extraction verb across several hazards; I infer that the focus asks what rescue can and cannot transform. A live alternative is that the repetitions only demonstrate divine power and are not meant to distinguish bodily from devotional change.

changed_reading.before: The rescue merely ends the sea danger before the relapse.
changed_reading.after: Rescue is one member of a repeated extraction technology: it reliably changes location and survival status, while 29:65 isolates its non-guarantee of durable allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The weak spider-house and the call to beings besides God turn shore-side partnership into refuge construction. Once the vessel crisis ends, the riders do not simply forget; they rebuild a distributed shelter from relationships whose protective structure is intrinsically weak.

activation_trace.role: The literal ship is an actually functioning shelter and carrier during exposure.
Partnership supplies the post-rescue distribution of protective or devotional claims.
The weaving spider supplies the maker of a visibly organized but inadequate refuge.
Dwelling and shelter make reliance architectural rather than merely doctrinal.
Weakness of force marks the substitute shelter's failure under real load.
Calling and inclining verbally links the substitute objects directly to the focus act of calling.
Calling an other besides God supplies the alternative addressee set that partnership repopulates.

structural_cues: 29:41 defines reliance on other protectors through a house analogy.
29:42 immediately returns to what is called besides God.
29:65 contrasts a functioning vessel under danger with renewed partnership after reaching land.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a real carrier, a weak constructed shelter, and calls to others; I infer that partners function as a shore-side protection architecture. A live alternative is that the spider-house targets patronage generally without specifying the motives behind 29:65.

changed_reading.before: On land they resume abstract polytheistic worship.
changed_reading.after: On land they resume building a distributed refuge system, replacing the rescuer with a web of protective claims precisely when immediate exposure has receded.

context_deltas.mechanism: The migration and provision cluster makes land the return of planning, carrying, allocation, and perceived control. Partnership can therefore be read as distributed reliance across a resource network, while the surrounding verses counter it with spacious earth, creatures that do not carry their provision, entrusted dependence, and divinely expanded or narrowed allotment.

activation_trace.role: Dry land supplies the domain where storage, routes, and ordinary provision management resume.
Partnership supplies the distribution of reliance among multiple perceived providers.
Spatial breadth counters the idea that dependence must remain fixed to one local support system.
Reliance and entrustment supply the alternative posture toward uncertain movement and livelihood.
Literal carrying foregrounds the burden of securing and transporting provision.
Apportioned giving relocates provision from the carrier's possession to an assigned supply.
Expansion and abundance supply one pole of changing material capacity.
Constriction to a narrow measure supplies the opposite pole of material capacity.

structural_cues: 29:56-60 move from spacious land and migration to reliance and the creature that does not carry its provision.
29:62 places expansion and restriction of provision under one agency.
29:65 locates renewed partnership exactly at the return to land.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies land, carrying, apportioned provision, reliance, and variable abundance; I infer that shore restores a resource-control calculus and that partnership distributes dependence within it. A live alternative is that the provision cluster addresses migration independently of the focus relapse.

changed_reading.before: Comfort after rescue causes a vague return to old beliefs.
changed_reading.after: Land reactivates the practical economy of carrying and controlling provision, so partnership becomes a strategy of distributed reliance that the context directly contests.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence repeatedly obtains the correct answer, God, yet pairs it with turning away, distraction, play, and post-rescue enjoyment. Activated by the circular vessel branch, the focus becomes the crisis phase of a larger recognition cycle: right naming is available, but ordinary absorption rotates conduct away from its implication.

activation_trace.role: Circular motion supplies the exploratory shape of recurring recognition and diversion.
The crisis call is the cycle's most concentrated act of correct address.
Naming the worshipped God as creator supplies correct explicit recognition before the focus.
Being turned from a proper direction supplies the directional failure that follows correct naming.
Repeated naming of God after rain and revived earth confirms that recognition is available outside maritime crisis too.
Occupation by something else supplies the mechanism that displaces recognized priority.
Action without a sound governing aim supplies conduct detached from acknowledged truth.
Enjoyed benefit supplies the post-rescue absorption through which denial is prolonged.

structural_cues: 29:61 and 29:63 repeat that they will say God when asked about creation and rain.
29:64 inserts distraction and play immediately before the focus.
29:66 grammatically continues the focus with denial of what was given and enjoyment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated correct naming, directional turning, diversion, and enjoyed benefit; I infer a recurring recognition-displacement circuit and use the circular vessel image only as its exploratory shape. A live alternative is a linear accusation of inconsistency with no cyclic implication.

changed_reading.before: Sea danger uniquely produces knowledge or recognition that disappears on shore.
changed_reading.after: Recognition is already present across ordinary creation, crisis, and rescue; what rotates is whether conduct remains governed by that recognition once diversion and benefit resume.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next security scene sharpens the shore transition into a problem of credit assignment. A bounded safe sanctuary exists amid people being snatched away around it, yet belief is assigned to falsehood and God's favor is denied. The focus partnership can thus name the reassignment of rescue and security credit after safety is received.

activation_trace.role: Divine extraction supplies the received safety whose attribution is at stake.
Land supplies the apparent secure zone in which causal credit is redistributed.
Partnership divides credit among claimants after a singular rescue.
A bounded sanctuary supplies concrete protected geography rather than generic comfort.
Security and trusting belief are paired within one root occurrence, exposing the relation between felt safety and assigned trust.
Rapid snatching supplies the surrounding counterfactual danger against which sanctuary safety is visible.
The area around a thing maps protection as a center encircled by exposure.
Loss of truth and stability marks the false recipient to which belief or credit is assigned.

structural_cues: 29:66 links the rescue to denial of what was given.
29:67 contrasts a safe bounded center with abduction around it.
The same verse opposes belief in falsehood to denial of God's favor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies received rescue, sanctuary security, surrounding seizure, falsehood-belief, and rejected favor; I infer that 29:65's partnership redistributes causal credit for safety. A live alternative is that 29:67 offers a separate civic sign rather than specifying the psychology of the shore response.

changed_reading.before: They become polytheists again once geographically safe.
changed_reading.after: Received safety becomes the very occasion for misattribution: singular rescue is converted into divided credit within a protected land system.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing effort, guidance, and paths convert the focus's short emergency passage into a duration test. Exclusive obedience is not only a call at the point of exposure; it must become a guided route carried through changing conditions.

activation_trace.role: Literal riding supplies a bounded journey whose allegiance changes with terrain.
Submission supplies the orientation that must persist beyond the emergency segment.
Exerting capacity under hardship extends the test from reactive danger to sustained effort.
Gentle direction toward a road or truth supplies continuing orientation after the crisis.
Traversable extended paths pluralize the terrain without pluralizing the governing allegiance.

structural_cues: 29:65 moves from riding to land and changes allegiance at the boundary.
29:69 closes the surah with effort followed by guidance into God's paths.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a short ride, exertion, guidance, and extended paths; I infer that durable sincerity is route-shaped rather than a momentary emergency peak. A live alternative is that 29:69 promises guidance generally without directly contrasting the riders.

changed_reading.before: The defect is that a sincere emergency moment is followed by a bad moment.
changed_reading.after: The defect is discontinuity of route: allegiance is concentrated at one hazardous segment but is not carried across the terrain change into sustained guided practice.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the truth-and-effective-action branch of ب ر ر inside the ordinary noun for dry land. It remains anchored in the exact focus root and in the immediate contrast between spoken devotion and subsequent action. Downstream prose should present it as lexical resonance, not assert that البر literally means moral truth here.

activation_trace.role: Dry land supplies the certain surface meaning and the scene of post-rescue conduct.
Truth that carries speech into action activates an ethical test at the same lexical landing point.
The sea call supplies the prior speech whose practical truth is tested after landing.
Renewed partnership supplies the action that fails to carry the singular call forward.

changed_reading.before: The shore is only the safe location where inconsistency appears.
changed_reading.after: The shore also resonates as the point where a spoken claim must become truth-bearing action, and the immediate partnership records its failure to do so.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's secondary mapping from د ع و to د ع ع and its images of violent pushing and successive collapse. It remains anchored in the focus call and the agitated vessel setting, where pressure visibly precedes address. Downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy for compelled salience, never as the lexical definition of دعوا.

activation_trace.role: Agitated coming and going supplies the physical pressure field around the call.
Violent pushing supplies an exploratory image of danger forcing one dependence to the foreground.
Successive falling supplies an exploratory cascade in which supports fail one after another until one addressee remains.
Purity after admixture names the resulting concentration once competing supports have fallen away.

changed_reading.before: Fear simply motivates a voluntary prayer.
changed_reading.after: The danger can be pictured as mechanically pushing and collapsing the support hierarchy until exclusive address is the remaining live response.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it overlays later eschatological enclosure on a concrete sea-to-land rescue. It remains anchored in نَجَّىٰهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ, whose mechanism is movement from inside danger to an apparent outside. Downstream prose should qualify it as a spatial analogy: the later verses challenge the finality of shore, not the reality of the maritime rescue.

activation_trace.role: Rescue by separation supplies movement out of one enclosing hazard.
Dry land supplies the apparent outside and endpoint of the local danger.
Enclosure by overpowering destruction supplies a later condition with no secure exterior.
A covering that generally envelops supplies the return of total exposure.
The upper direction closes one side of the imagined escape space.
The lower direction closes the opposite side of the imagined escape space.

changed_reading.before: Reaching shore is an unqualified move outside danger.
changed_reading.after: Shore is a real local outside but not a final outside: the larger spatial field can close again above and below, making renewed partnership a false inference from temporary clearance.

strongest_changes: The testing frame recasts crisis sincerity as a locally true assay result rather than proof of stable identity.
Repeated rescues distinguish reliable bodily extraction from the unresolved transformation of allegiance.
The provision cluster and the sanctuary contrast make land a domain of resumed control, distributed reliance, and reassigned credit for safety.
Repeated correct naming, turning, diversion, and enjoyment expand the sea-shore reversal into a recognition cycle.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed a dense interaction between the focus's two separation roots, the earlier rescue series, the spider-house model of substitute protection, and the immediate creation-provision-sanctuary sequence. It supported several coexisting mechanisms instead of reducing the ayah to generic inconsistency.
remaining_uncertainties: The circular فلك activation may be a useful branch resonance without implying that the verse itself encodes recurrence.
The ethical ب ر ر reading is anchored but should remain a lexical echo beside the certain dry-land sense.
The resource-control reading depends on treating the nearby migration and provision sequence as causal illumination of shore-side partnership.
The secondary د ع ع mapping explains pressure-driven salience only as an exploratory material analogy.
